en.topic_title: Exclusive: In 2010 letter, Trump pleaded with Macau leader to correct ‘outrageous’ trademark defeat, attaching TV ratings
en.topic_summary:
In 2006, the same year that Macau overtook Las Vegas to become the world’s biggest gambling hub, Donald J. Trump was trying to make inroads into the Special Administrative Region of China. But there was a snag: his company name was already registered to local residents.



File photo: The White House, via Flickr.
